2021_220_8_b_24680_troy_school_district_.paragraph: Federal Awards Supplemental Information for Troy School District covering the year ended June 30, 2021, presented to the Board of Education and comprising three independent auditor's reports, the Schedule of Expenditures of Federal Awards, a reconciliation to the basic financial statements, notes, and the Schedule of Findings and Questioned Costs. Total federal awards expended for the year were $15,244,795, against award amounts (memo only) of $23,667,645. The single major federal program tested was the Coronavirus Relief Fund, CFDA 21.019, on which the auditor issued an unmodified compliance opinion; no material weaknesses, significant deficiencies, or audit findings were reported, and the School District qualified as a low-risk auditee.
2021_220_8_b_24680_troy_school_district_.page:
**Nature of the report**
Supplemental federal awards package for Troy School District for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2021, issued as required by Title 2 CFR Part 200 (the Uniform Guidance). Contents: Report on Schedule of Expenditures of Federal Awards (page 1); Report on Internal Control Over Financial Reporting and on Compliance and Other Matters Based on an Audit of Financial Statements Performed in Accordance with Government Auditing Standards (pages 2-3); Report on Compliance for Each Major Federal Program and Report on Internal Control Over Compliance Required by the Uniform Guidance (pages 4-5); Schedule of Expenditures of Federal Awards (pages 6-9); Reconciliation of Basic Financial Statements Federal Revenue with the Schedule (page 10); Notes (page 11); Schedule of Findings and Questioned Costs (page 12).

**Auditor's opinions**
All three reports are addressed to the Board of Education and/or management of Troy School District and are dated October 5, 2021, the same date as the report on the basic financial statements, which carried an unmodified opinion. The supplemental schedules are stated to be fairly stated in all material respects in relation to the financial statements as a whole. No deficiencies in internal control over financial reporting were identified that the auditor considers material weaknesses, and tests of compliance disclosed no instances of noncompliance reportable under Government Auditing Standards. The auditor expressed an unmodified opinion that the School District complied in all material respects with compliance requirements having a direct and material effect on its major federal program for the year ended June 30, 2021, and identified no material weaknesses in internal control over compliance.

**Reconciliation to the financial statements**
Revenue from federal sources as reported on the financial statements (all funds) $15,532,995; less federal revenue for which the School District is considered a beneficiary rather than a subrecipient ($288,200); federal expenditures per the schedule $15,244,795.

**Findings and questioned costs**
Type of auditor's report on the financial statements: unmodified. No material weaknesses or significant deficiencies in internal control over financial reporting; no noncompliance material to the financial statements. For federal awards: no material weaknesses or significant deficiencies in internal control over major programs; unmodified compliance opinion; no findings required to be reported under 2 CFR 200.516(a). Major program identified: CFDA 21.019, Coronavirus Relief Fund. Type A/Type B dollar threshold: $750,000. Auditee qualified as low-risk: yes. Section II (financial statement audit findings): none. Section III (federal program audit findings): none.
2021_220_8_b_24680_troy_school_district_.verbose:
Federal Awards Supplemental Information for Troy School District for the year ended June 30, 2021, prepared under Title 2 U.S. Code of Federal Regulations Part 200, Uniform Administrative Requirements, Cost Principles, and Audit Requirements for Federal Awards (the Uniform Guidance), and presented to the Board of Education. The package contains: the Report on Schedule of Expenditures of Federal Awards Required by the Uniform Guidance (page 1); the Report on Internal Control Over Financial Reporting and on Compliance and Other Matters Based on an Audit of Financial Statements Performed in Accordance with Government Auditing Standards (pages 2-3); the Report on Compliance for Each Major Federal Program and Report on Internal Control Over Compliance Required by the Uniform Guidance (pages 4-5); the Schedule of Expenditures of Federal Awards (pages 6-9); the Reconciliation of Basic Financial Statements Federal Revenue with the Schedule of Expenditures of Federal Awards (page 10); Notes to the Schedule (page 11); and the Schedule of Findings and Questioned Costs (page 12).

AUDITOR'S REPORTS. All three reports are dated October 5, 2021. The auditor audited the financial statements of the governmental activities, each major fund, and the aggregate remaining fund information of Troy School District as of and for the year ended June 30, 2021, and issued a report dated October 5, 2021 containing an unmodified opinion; no procedures were performed with respect to the audited financial statements subsequent to October 5, 2021. The schedule of expenditures of federal awards and the reconciliation are presented for purposes of additional analysis, are not a required part of the basic financial statements, and in the auditor's opinion are fairly stated in all material respects in relation to the financial statements as a whole. Under Government Auditing Standards, the auditor did not identify any deficiencies in internal control over financial reporting considered to be material weaknesses, and tests of compliance with provisions of laws, regulations, contracts, and grant agreements disclosed no instances of noncompliance or other matters required to be reported. On compliance for the major federal program, the auditor expressed an unmodified opinion that the School District complied in all material respects with the types of compliance requirements described in the OMB Compliance Supplement that could have a direct and material effect on its major federal program for the year ended June 30, 2021, and identified no deficiencies in internal control over compliance considered to be material weaknesses.

NOTES. Note 1, Basis of Presentation: the Schedule includes the federal grant activity of Troy School District under programs of the federal government for the year ended June 30, 2021, presented in accordance with the Uniform Guidance, and presents only a selected portion of operations, so it does not present financial position, changes in net position, or cash flows. Note 2, Summary of Significant Accounting Policies: expenditures are reported on the same basis of accounting as the basic financial statements and are recognized under the Uniform Guidance cost principles, except those related to CFDA 21.019, Coronavirus Relief Fund, which instead follow U.S. Department of Treasury guidance and frequently asked questions as codified in the Federal Register; negative amounts represent adjustments or credits to amounts reported as expenditures in prior years; pass-through entity identifying numbers are presented where available; the School District elected not to use the 10 percent de minimis indirect cost rate. Note 3, Grant Auditor Report: management used the Cash Management System (CMS) Grant Auditor Report in preparing the schedule, and unreconciled differences, if any, were disclosed to the auditor. Note 4, Noncash Assistance: the value of noncash assistance received was determined in accordance with Uniform Guidance provisions.

SCHEDULE OF FINDINGS AND QUESTIONED COSTS. Federal awards: material weaknesses in internal control over major programs, no; significant deficiencies, none reported; type of auditor's report on compliance for major programs, unmodified; audit findings required to be reported under 2 CFR 200.516(a), no. Major program identified: CFDA 21.019, Coronavirus Relief Fund. Dollar threshold used to distinguish between type A and type B programs, $750,000. Auditee qualified as a low-risk auditee, yes. Section II, Financial Statement Audit Findings: none. Section III, Federal Program Audit Findings: none.
